## Four fixes the sharded browser suite caught · _v1.98.0 (engine/index.ts topPaintableIn; ui/panels/prompt-improver.ts mode, resolveUse; ui/panels/generate-image.ts; app.ts readClipboardItems; ui/task-bar.ts place; ui/panel-group.ts fitTabs width)

- A folder with a new, never-painted layer said "has no visible pixel layer to work on": `topPaintableIn` required `x.raster`, and a fresh layer gets its raster on first paint. It now also takes a visible plain pixel layer w/o a raster (not type, smart, vector, shape, fill or adjustment). Removed condition, quoted: `x.raster`.
- Improve Prompt in Generate Image sent the edit rules: with Rewrite for on Auto, `resolveUse` fell through to `'edit'` because Generate Image set no `mode`. `mode` may now return `'new'`, which resolves to no use case; Generate Image sets it. Fill, expand and upscale are unchanged.
- Edit > Paste with clipboard reading refused at once (Chromium rejects `read()` w/ NotAllowedError instead of waiting) pasted formvis's own copy w/o the blocked-clipboard message; a NotAllowedError now raises the same toast as the denied and 4 s cases. Other read errors pass through as before.
- The Contextual Task Bar was wider than the room beside the right docks (compact bar 793 px against 770 at 1400 by 900, 1.96.2's model picker), so it ran under the Properties column. `place()` caps `max-width` at the room minus the pads before measuring, only when the value changes; the prompt field already flexes, so nothing else moves.
- Panel group tabs could be cut on wider fonts: `fitTabs` summed `scrollWidth`, which leaves out each tab's 1 px borders. The sum now adds `offsetWidth - clientWidth` a tab.
- Verified: tsc --noEmit; the failing browser tests and their files pass locally (21 tests: task bar, measuring, fal models, improve prompt, generative models, local generation, paste); paint targets and prompt use cases pass. Not verified under 4x CPU and network throttling.

## The quick fill command takes a preference area · _v1.97.1 (app.ts `content-fill`, automation/command-meta.ts)

- Why: Custom's brush exists only in the dialog, so an agent had no way to give the fill a preferred place. `content-fill` now declares `prefer` (a list of `{x, y, width, height}` rectangles in document pixels) and `strength` (0 to 0.6). With `prefer` it builds a document-sized 0 or 1 map and calls `Engine.contentAwareFillWith(null, 'current', undefined, false, null, 3, map, strength)`: the map goes in as `preferDoc`, the weight, and `limitDoc` stays null. Without `prefer` the command is the plain quick fill as before. Non-finite rectangles are skipped; `contentFill` still clamps the strength to `FILL_PREFERENCE_MAX`.
- No removed code. The skill `steering-selection-aware-fill` (formvis-driving) teaches the steps; there is deliberately no parameter that limits the fill.
- Verified: tsc --noEmit and vite build. Not run in the window.

## Selection-Aware Fill: the painted sampling area is a preference weight · _v1.97.0 (engine/retouch.ts contentFill, FillPreference; engine/index.ts contentAwareFillWith; ui/panels/content-fill-dialog.ts; the name in app.ts, command-meta.ts and every i18n table)

- Why: a painted area that limits where patches may come from is declined for patent risk. Custom keeps its brush, but the painted pixels now only lower the cost of candidate patches that lie in them.
- `contentFill(px, mask, w, h, limit, options, prefer)`: the fifth parameter is now `limit`, used only for the automatic Rectangular box. The new seventh, `prefer: { mask, strength }`, builds a summed-area table of the painted pixels; each candidate's cost multiplier is `1 - strength * painted share of its patch`, strength clamped to `FILL_PREFERENCE_MAX` (0.6), so a candidate is never cheaper than 0.4 times its plain cost. Nothing is rejected for lying outside the painted area; the region still grows to take painted pixels in. Candidates in the painted area get their own 8000 budget when thinned, so the preference is not lost to subsampling. The cost loop compares `cost * mult` with the best so far.
- Dialog: a Preference Strength slider (0 to 0.6 step 0.05, default 0.4) after the brush row, enabled only for Custom (the same disabled and is-off toggle as the brush size row, so nothing mounts or unmounts). Custom passes the painted area as `prefer`; Rectangular passes its automatic box as `limit`; Auto passes neither. `Engine.contentAwareFillWith(limitDoc, output, options, sampleAll, areaDoc, channel, preferDoc, strength)`.
- Removed: Custom no longer passes its brush area as the hard mask. The old line was `contentFill(pm, hole, w, h, this.sampling === 'auto' ? null : allow, this.opts)` and the old OK built one `allowDoc` for both Rectangular and Custom. An empty painted area used to make the fill refuse; now it simply fills with no preference.
- Name: Content-Aware Fill became Selection-Aware Fill (dialog title, Edit menu, Quick fill, history step and layer name, notices, Photomerge's fill option, command words, docs, all 27 language tables; es-MX and fr-CA follow es and fr). The Content-Aware Move tool and the Content-Aware option labels of Fill, Patch, Heal and Crop keep their names.
- Verified: tsc --noEmit; vitest 222 of 222. Quality compared old against new on 7 sample images (see the planning sidecar). Not verified in the window under throttling.

Removed: `html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #0a0a0a; ... }` (split into html and body rules), `<p>Starting the formvis engine</p>`. objc2-app-kit gains `objc2-core-foundation` for setAlphaValue.

The macOS alpha path type-checks for aarch64-apple-darwin; not run on a Mac.

## Traffic lights centred on both axes · _v1.95.9 (src-tauri/src/traffic_lights.rs, src-tauri/src/main.rs)

- The owner's 1.95.8 screenshot: the lights still sat near the top of the window, not centred in the 38 px row. 1.95.8 copied Tao's inset arithmetic, and that arithmetic is the fault: it sets the title bar container's height to the button height plus y (26 px) and changes each button's x only, so the buttons keep the system's own height whatever y is. Re-applying it more often could never move them down.
- inset now sizes the container to the whole row (ROW 38) at the top of the window and sets each button's origin on both axes: x at LEFT 14 plus the system's own spacing, y at (ROW minus the button height) / 2. Tao's `traffic_light_position` is no longer passed, since its drawRect would put its own 26 px container back on every redraw. place runs the inset at once and again 120 ms later, after AppKit's own layout pass. Removed: `const INSET: (f64, f64) = (14.0, 12.0);`, `let (x, y) = INSET;`, `let height = close_frame.size.height + y;`, `content.setNeedsDisplay(true)` and, in main.rs, `.traffic_light_position(tauri::LogicalPosition::new(traffic_lights::INSET.0, traffic_lights::INSET.1));`.

## Traffic lights on the Home screen, fonts off the main thread, the macOS engine folder · _v1.95.8 (ui/tabs.ts, src-tauri/src/traffic_lights.rs, src-tauri/src/main.rs, src-tauri/src/packaged.rs, src-tauri/build.rs, src-tauri/capabilities/default.json, src-tauri/tauri.macos.conf.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml)

- The owner's report: on the Home screen the macOS traffic lights sat above the title row and moved into place only once a document opened. It runs after the window is built, when a page load finishes, on Resized, Focused, ThemeChanged and ScaleFactorChanged of the main window, and after every title the page gives.

The command is in build.rs APP_COMMANDS and the capability, since the window's origin is remote. objc2-app-kit gains NSWindow, NSButton, NSControl, NSView and NSResponder, objc2-foundation NSGeometry.
- system_fonts and system_fonts_english are `#[tauri::command(async)]`: a plain command runs on the main thread, the page asks for the fonts at start, and reading a few thousand installed fonts held the window (and its title bar) still right after it appeared.
- The engine on macOS is a one-folder build in the bundle's Resources/engine (see the backend log); packaged::engine_folder finds `engine/formvis-engine` there or beside the binary (`tauri dev`), and main.rs starts it by path, falling back to the one-file sidecar elsewhere. tauri.macos.conf.json empties externalBin and adds the `engine` resource.

## .shc in the published layout; native dialogs and low latency checked · _v1.95.1 (io/shc.ts)

- shc.ts (agent shc): the old private layout (u16 version, u16 count, 5-byte points) became the published one: 8BFS, u16 version, u32 count; per contour u32 record version 1 or 2, a UTF-16BE name with its u32 length counting the final null, u16 curve format (2), u16 point count, u16 vertical then u16 horizontal per point, version 2's u8 smooth flags after the pairs, u32 min and max input. Corner flags are read past and written back as smooth. No shareable third-party .shc was found; the fixtures are hand-written to the layout and decoded independently in the test.
- Native dialogs (desktop, no code change): under Xvfb without a window manager the GTK dialog needs XSetInputFocus before typing, and a leading slash opens the Open dialog's location field. Save As always ends in .fvd: a typed name ending in another extension gets .fvd added.
- Low-latency drawing (no code change): the CPU scene canvas reports desynchronized true only with the preference on; predicted events drive the tip hover only; coalesced events are replayed whatever the preference. The WebGPU and native displays take the option and ignore it.

## Flatten on workers, deep Box Blur bands, WebAssembly membrane · _v1.95.0 (engine/composite-bands.ts, engine/composite-worker.ts, engine/index.ts, engine/deep-bands.ts, engine/deep-filters.ts, engine/retouch.ts, engine/wasm-kernels.ts, native/formvis-kernels/src/heal.rs)

- compositeFlatRaster (agent arena2): workers return each band as transferToImageBitmap and the page draws it source-over onto a transparent Raster, which keeps the premultiplied bytes, so Flatten and Merge Visible match the main thread for alpha below 255 too. compositeFlat (ImageData, export) still declines alpha below 255: getImageData then putImageData unpremultiplies and premultiplies again. Qualifying: 8-bit RGB, no folders, no tiled layers; Merge Visible also needs every visible layer inside the canvas. busyWith is set while it runs; flattenImage returns at once. The old bodies are flattenOnMain and mergeVisibleWith(null).
- deep-filters.ts boxMeanBlocked (agent deepbands): the deep Box Blur's summed-area table is rebuilt per absolute 512-row block starting r rows above it, and its bands start on block boundaries (deepBandRows), so band and whole layer add the same numbers in the same order. The main-thread deep Box Blur differs from 1.94.9 in the last bit only. Deep bands are Float32 for 16-bit too (16-bit is quantized at save), and have run on workers since 1.92.0; the ledger text was stale.
- heal.rs fv_membrane (agent wasmk2): the harmonic membrane of solveMembrane in f64 arithmetic over f32 storage, same neighbor order, same coarse seeding and no fused multiply-add, so the floats are identical; used from 256 cells. Left in TypeScript on purpose: Gaussian Add Noise (ln and cos differ between Rust's libm and V8) and Select > Color Range (its own per-mode loop).

## Layered .af reading, .comp 8 to 15, composite queue, WebAssembly dither and resample gate · _v1.94.9 (io/af-read.ts, io/af-preview.ts, io/project-io.ts, engine/composite-bands.ts, engine/band-pool.ts, engine/index.ts, engine/wasm-kernels.ts, native/formvis-kernels)

- af-read.ts (agent afread, read direction ported from schist's MIT codec-affinity): container, file-table savepoints, zlib (DecompressionStream) and zstd (fzstd, loaded on first use) entries with prediction undone and CRC checked, the object graph, planar 256 px tiles (formats 0 to 4, 6, 9) and source-backed tiles through createImageBitmap. Placement comes from the Xfrm chain only (BitR places nothing); a folder's Xfrm is its children's space; no Blnd with PasT not false is pass-through, PasT false is isolate. Tile stride is the file's TWi. Limits: 2^26 pixels a bitmap, 3 x 2^26 in all, 512 MB decompressed, 4,000 layers, depth 64 (layers) and 200 (graph), 2^22 nodes. Unread kinds are named in the open notice; the preview stays as a hidden layer when anything is left out, and stays the whole result when no raster is read.
- project_format.py and project-io.ts: .comp versions 1 to 15. A comp-shaped id with any other version is refused with the version named. Version 13 OpenEXR layers are decoded in the contained EXR process and handed to the page as 8-bit PNG clipped to white (straight alpha), the record marked hdrClipped. The page maps comp guides (vertical or horizontal, position) to axis x or y, version 9 adjustment settings (blurRadius, motionAngle, motionDistance, noiseAmount, noiseGaussian, noiseMonochromatic, noiseSeed) to formvis's keys, and keeps text with colorRuns or fontRuns as pixels, since live text would drop the runs. 16-bit PNGs decode at 8 bits in the browser.
- composite-bands.ts (agent arena): the composite pool takes turns by priority (viewport and float 0, export 1) instead of one promise chain. compositeFlat backs PNG and WebP export with the preference on; it returns null for JPEG (white fill first), for any pixel with alpha below 255 and for documents the band route declines. bandPoolStats counts shared and copied bands. Flatten and Merge Visible stay on the main thread.
- wasm-kernels.ts and dither.rs (agent wasmk): the ordered dither used f64 % (an fmod call a pixel) and is now floor arithmetic with the row index hoisted; resampling uses WebAssembly only when the output is at most 60 percent of the source pixels. The served module URL carries Vite's ?t= suffix after a hot update, so a test's own dynamic import can be a second instance with its own counters.

## Slow file dialog way out, native renderer graphics API · _v1.94.8 (io/disk.ts, io/links.ts, ui/toast.ts, app.ts, ui/prefs.ts, ui/panels/page-prefs.ts, src-tauri/src/main.rs, build.rs, capabilities)

- disk.ts watched(): every system file dialog call (open, save, the linked-file pick) races a way out. After dialogWatch.afterMs (20 s) app.ts shows a notice with Stop waiting; that answers the call as cancelled and asks the shell for file_dialog_report. The notice is taken down when the dialog does come back. A desktop file portal that fails OpenFile leaves GTK's call waiting with nothing on screen (seen with a stand-in portal under Xvfb), so time is the only sign; 20 s is long enough not to bother someone still choosing a file. The hung call stays in the shell; the page no longer waits on it.
- toast() returns a function that takes that notice down; callers that ignore it are unchanged.
- dialog_report on Linux now says whether the file portal is used (GTK_USE_PORTAL=1, Flatpak or Snap).
- main.rs apply_graphics_backend: Preferences > Performance > Native Renderer Graphics API is kept in `graphics-backend` beside `display-server` (Linux), in %APPDATA%\formvis (Windows) or ~/Library/Application Support/formvis (macOS), and set as WGPU_BACKEND before the window exists, which the native renderer's wgpu instance reads (InstanceDescriptor ... from_env). An environment value is never replaced. Options follow the system: Automatic, Vulkan, OpenGL on Linux; Metal on macOS; DirectX 12, Vulkan, OpenGL on Windows.
- gpu/bench.ts, ui/app-dialogs.ts (PC-AU-0211, agent bench): Run never finished on a software GPU, where one GPU frame can block the page for 14 to 30 s and frames never yielded. Each path now has a 4 s cap and a per-frame Promise.race; a path with fewer than 3 frames in the cap is partial and the same display's later tests are skipped with the reason; unavailable displays are skipped rows. Results are P50 and P95 against a P95 budget per path (budgetFor), with peak usedJSHeapSize where performance.memory exists. The baseline is localStorage `formvis.benchBaseline` (P95 by test and path); a rise over 20 percent is a regression. BenchRow's p90Ms became p95Ms with key, state, reason, budgetMs and within; setup/bench.py follows. The cap cannot interrupt one GPU call, so Cancel takes effect at the next frame.

## Monitor profile per screen and on move · _v1.94.7 (src-tauri/src/display.rs, ui/colour.ts)

- display.rs: display_profile takes the window and reads the profile for its screen's place among the system's screens, sorted left to right then top to bottom, as X screens of a side-by-side setup are numbered (the ICC Profiles in X convention: `_ICC_PROFILE` for the first, `_ICC_PROFILE_<n>` for screen n; a screen without its own falls back to the first). The answer carries `monitor`. macOS and Windows still read the main display only. The Rust test sets `_ICC_PROFILE_1` and reads it back for screen 1.

- Testing: Xvfb has one output, and GDK lists only RandR monitors that have one, so two screens cannot be made here; the desktop test checks the re-read on move. Keep an X connection open while setting root properties on Xvfb: it resets, dropping them, when its last client leaves.
- SC-AI-0108 (no code change): e2e/desktop/test_linux_desktop_attention.py shows the Assistant's question moving WM_HINTS from flags 103 to 359 (XUrgencyHint) with the window unfocused, and no change while focused. Its fake model is set on the shared engine for a few seconds and the previous row restored.

## Launch arguments that run something · _v1.94.6 (src-tauri/src/main.rs, src-tauri/build.rs, src-tauri/capabilities/default.json, io/disk.ts, app.ts)

- main.rs runs_from_args: `--command`, `--action` and `--script` each take the next argument; a script is read in the shell (a page served from the engine cannot read a path) and sent as text, at most 200 KB, or as an `error` run the page reports. paths_from_args skips the value after these flags, so a .js given to `--script` is not opened as a document. The runs share OpenQueue with the files: queued until the page calls take_pending_runs, then emitted as `formvis://launch-runs`; the single-instance callback forwards a second launch's runs the same way. take_pending_runs is in build.rs APP_COMMANDS and the capability list, since the window's origin is remote.
- disk.ts listenShell chains every open and run on one promise, so runs wait for the files of their launch; app.ts runs each through Commands.call (play-action with name, script-browse with source) and turns a refusal or error into a notice without stopping the rest.
- Building the debug shell needs `frontend/dist` and the `binaries/formvis-engine-<triple>` resource to exist; both are ignored by git. A placeholder engine script and a copy of a vite build are enough for `cargo build`.

- lut-read.ts fromLook: an Iridas .look is XML whose first LUT element carries a quoted size and a quoted hex string, eight hex digits per little-endian float32, three per node, red fastest like .cube; it becomes .cube text so the rest of Color Lookup is unchanged. Found by the XML as well as by name. The order is checked in lut-read.test.ts with a channel-rotating table.

- extensions/tools/relight.ts (SC-ED-0167): Delete, H, the wheel over a handle and Ctrl-click add were already there. A plain click on empty canvas now adds a light and drags it; Alt and Shift empty-canvas drags still move the aim and the pattern center. The wheel acts on the light under the pointer or else the selected one, by 3 per notch through the session's adjust (no separate undo step); Ctrl, Meta and Alt pass through to zoom. Hidden handles are not hit-tested, a click while hidden does nothing, and the flag resets when the session ends. L belongs to the Lasso tool, so the Lights tool keeps no key.

## Live shapes warp as vectors, Chromatic Shift, gallery commands, filter dialog preview and reset, spelling keys · _v1.94.3 (engine/index.ts, engine/transform-entry.ts, engine/filters-lib/distort.ts, engine/filter-library.ts, app.ts, ui/panels/filter-panel.ts, ui/panels/controls.ts, automation/command-meta.ts, backend/app/routers/mcp.py, i18n tables, about 40 UI and engine files for spelling)

- applyMeshWarp and shapeThrough (Distort, Perspective): a plain Rectangle or Ellipse layer (`layer.shape`, no `layer.vector`, no pixel mask) is converted with liveShapeVector inside the same history step, then reshaped through warpVector; before, reshape returned early and the raster path ran. `layer.shape` is cleared on purpose: it is the parametric record, and a warped outline is no longer a rectangle or ellipse, so the layer continues as a vector shape. Checked: masks agree within 1 px dilation in 9 cases (drag, arc, wave, flag, fisheye, twist).
- chromaticShiftImage (distort.ts): Plates offsets R, G and B in three directions; Lateral scales R out and B in about the centre; Linear moves R and B apart along Angle. As a library filter it gets the menu entry, filter layer, smart filter, actions and MCP apply_filter at once.
- Filter Gallery effects had no command: `filter-fx-<key>` is registered for each of the 47 (optional `values`), words from a `/^filter-fx-/` family in command-meta.ts. FilterPanel.showWith(kind, settings) opens a gallery effect with settings filled.
- Filter dialog: Preview moved from a body row to the footer (`cv-adjust-preview`, as in the adjustment dialog); filters with their own preview hide it with visibility so the footer does not move. Every sliderRow gets `def` (defaultFilterSettings, the lens and gallery defaults, library p.def, Develop's fresh state); the double-click reset is one function on the label and the range. Removed, verbatim: `this.previewRow = checkRow('Preview', (v) => { this.preview = v; this.schedule(0); });`, `this.body.append(this.previewRow.el, this.depthLimit.el);`, `setHidden(this.previewRow.el, !!lib?.ownPreview);`, `this.body.insertBefore(node, this.previewRow.el);`.
- Spelling: 17 keys renamed with all 27 extra/ tables; orphan British keys 'Colour', 'Centre' (top tables) and 'Colours' (more/) removed after checking no source uses them. Two unused British keys remain in more/ ('The stroke is centred on the outline...', 'Encoded preview at 100 percent, centre of the image.').

## Frequency split rounding, deep Glow and XMP, Properties into an open dialog, Haze optional depth, UI audit 2 · _v1.94.0 (engine/retouch.ts, bloom.ts, develop.ts, io/crs-xmp.ts, engine/index.ts, ui/adjust-props.ts, ui/panels/adjust-panel.ts, engine/filter-library.ts, filters-lib/dither.ts, ui/panels/filter-panel.ts, ui/status.ts, ui/number-fields.ts and dialog and panel styles)

- frequencySplit: Linear Light rebuilds low + 2*high - 255, so high must be (diff+255)/2, a half for even differences. The old `h[i + c] = clamp(Math.round((s[i + c] - l[i + c]) / 2 + 128), 0, 255);` (removed) biased +1 or +2. Now floor((diff+255)/2), plus 1 for even differences where x+y is odd: exact for odd, a zero-mean checkerboard of 1 for even (measured max 1, mean 0.00).
- bloom takes Float32 data unrounded, so developDeep runs Glow last without quantising a deep layer. crs-xmp writes and reads GlowAmount, GlowRadius, GlowThreshold, GlowWarmth, GlowDiffusion (formvis's own names; they round-trip within formvis).
- The adjustment dialog holds the one live-edit session, so the Properties panel's own beginLive returned false and dropped the change. Engine.liveActive lets adjust-props write into the open session, and the dialog's adoptOutside() pulls the changed params into its draft on 'doc' (layer mode, preview on, parametric kinds).
- Haze by Depth: the filter panel refused any image param left empty; LibParam image params may be `optional`, and Haze's depth is.
- Status bar: the busy slot (296 px reserved) and the proof slot (170 px) held the space before the hint. The busy slot moves to the end and shows only while a job runs, and the proof slot collapses when empty. fitHint() keeps whole " · " parts that fit (ResizeObserver), with the full text as the title.
- Number scrub popup: placed beside the dialog frame, centred on the field (right if it fits, else left, else below).
- Layer Style note: the internal tag "(M2)" removed from the user-facing text.

## Bucket region on a worker, 32-bit transfer memo, per-model generate sizes · _v1.92.7 (engine/wand-jobs.ts, engine/wand-worker.ts, engine/index.ts, engine/compose-float.ts, ui/panels/generate-panel.ts, ui/panels/generate-image.ts, ui/panels/model-canvas-dialog.ts, ui/app-dialogs.ts)

- Bucket: findRegion (wandMask, then softenMask, the old inline anti-alias loop moved byte for byte) runs on its own long-lived worker at WAND_FROM (4 MP) from a copy of the rendered layer; busyWith is set while it runs and a switched document drops the result; null from the worker falls back to the main thread. Removed from paintBucket: `let mask = wandMask(data, W, H, x, y, this.bucket.tolerance, this.bucket.contiguous, 0); if (this.bucket.antiAlias) { const soft = new Uint8Array(mask.length); ... mask = soft; }`.
- Bands already use the shared arena and view-centre priority (1.91.2, 1.92.2); the ledger text saying structured clone was stale.
- 32-bit transfer memo: with m === 1 the result depends only on (channel, float32 bits), so a direct-mapped table (65,536 slots, key 0xffffffff empty, hash Math.imul(bits, 2654435761) >>> 16) returns the exact double the old loop computed; m > 1, NaN and kernel adjustments keep the old loop, whose text is unchanged. About 2.3 MB per adjustment per compose.
- Generate sizes: the panel's fixed SIZES became shapesFor(model); sizeChoice keeps a remembered size the current model does not offer; paintShapes patches option nodes in place (no select rebuild). fal's 1440 limit mirrors generative.py. Kept ComfyUI workflows have no size data and stay on the common five.
- Vivid Light folders (still refused): Chromium's canvas unpremultiply is bit-exact with float32 rint(((p/255) * (1/(a/255))) * 255) over all 32,895 pairs, so ties go either way by alpha; premul8's floor(x + 0.5) always rounds up. A WGSL version broke other ties (fused arithmetic). The Multiply lowp alpha is 1 low in some overlaps.

## GPU opacity ceiling, 16-bit transfer tables, native clipped groups, exact MP4 rate · _v1.92.6 (engine/gpu-dab.ts, engine/stroke.ts, engine/transfer-pow.ts, engine/compose-float.ts, gpu/native-display.ts, io/api.ts, app.ts, ui/app-dialogs.ts, styles/dialogs.css)

- Opacity ceiling: a per-pixel max of the dab opacity, kept in a second R32F texture drawn with blendEquation(MAX) (WebGL2 core has no per-attachment blend equations, so it is a second draw per dab); the shader's discard gives the CPU's `a > 0` condition. Removed: `if (!this.gpuWanted || this.buf.ceil) return false;`.
- open(w, h, lw, lh) refuses a non-tiled layer that could ever pass MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE or 64 M px, so the GPU decision is made before the first dab. Tiled strokes keep the window as the cap, so their ensure() fallback remains (untested; the window stayed near 4,160 px).
- transferLut caches the adjustment's own transfer per 16-bit grid value (exactly `Math.fround(Math.round(x*65535)/65535) === x`); off-grid values run the transfer as before, so output is exact. Up to four 512 KB tables per call, not shared. Removed the per-pixel loop `for (let c = 0; c < A; c++) { const v = toValue(out[i + c]), nv = clamp01(t(c, v * 255) / 255); out[i + c] = fromValue(v + (nv - v) * k); }`. 32-bit Levels and Curves stay on the old loop (the wasm pow could flip a float32 ulp).
- Native: a folder's mask reaches the renderer as the `folders` chain on each child, not as `mask` on the folder entry; the masked Hue/Reflect check reads that chain (foldersWithin). Removed: `if (l.sub.some((x) => x.clip)) return 'a clipped group, which the native renderer does not draw yet';`. CLIPPED_GROUP_BLENDS lists only the eight measured (2-level bar). Vivid Light folders stay refused: 3 to 7 levels on the folder's soft edge; Chromium rounds exact .5 ties down when it un-premultiplies, which did not explain it.
- MP4: encodeVideo sends the timeline fps; the engine no longer derives the rate from 83 ms delays (12.048 fps).
- New Document: `.cv-nd-colour[hidden]` keeps its box with visibility hidden (display none made the select jump). Removed `<option value="custom">Custom...</option>` and `.cv-nd-colour[hidden] { display: none; }`.

## ComfyUI upscaler source, prompt use cases, canvas srcover backdrop, GPU brush everywhere but opacity dynamics, video undo frame · _v1.92.5 (ui/panels/generative-dialog.ts, io/api.ts, io/comfy.ts, io/prompt-templates.ts, ui/panels/prompt-improver.ts, gpu/native-display.ts, engine/stroke.ts, engine/dab-buffer.ts, engine/index.ts, engine/transfer-pow.ts; tests)

- ComfyUI upscalers load into an optgroup after the dialog opens (an unreachable ComfyUI must not delay it) and only the group's options are swapped; the result is drawn at the dialog's factor like the local upscalers.
- Prompt use: the purpose sentence is appended on the window side, so the engine's /improve request is unchanged; the five new starter texts avoid apostrophes and braces so the in-step backend test can parse the TypeScript list with one regex.
- Native backdrop: the canvas composites premultiplied source-over as `s + ((d * (256 - sa)) >> 8)` on colour and alpha (the legacy 8-bit blitter rule; not (v + 255) >> 8), exact at opacity 1; below 1 it stays on the float path. Removed `if (l.hood?.kind === 2) return 'an HDR Toning adjustment layer, ...';`, the Blend If underlying-range condition and `const BLEND_IF_OPEN: readonly number[] = [0, 0, 255, 255];`. Masked Hue and Reflect folders, Vivid Light folders and clipped groups still refuse.
- GPU brush: layOnGpu now declines only for opacity dynamics (buf.ceil); the lifted paths read coverage only through compose after readInto. The fast path needs exactly zero in m[1] and m[2] (the old 1e-9 tolerance would change rounding). Open: a flat stroke whose window grows past the GPU's maximum texture falls back mid-stroke in ensure() and then differs from a pure CPU stroke (seen at 12,755 px on SwiftShader's 8,192 limit).
- Video undo: restore() sets the playhead to the current frame but the snapshot's rasters are of the frame the step was taken at; it now shows the playhead's frame from the restored layers.
- transfer-pow: table-based log and exp (3e-14 relative error), bit-identical in TS and wasm, still unwired (Exposure slower than Math.pow in Chromium).

## Layered TIFF open, exact GPU brush coverage, native Hue folders, staged deep transfer kernel · _v1.92.4 (app.ts, engine/dab-buffer.ts, engine/gpu-dab.ts, engine/stroke.ts, gpu/native-display.ts, engine/index.ts, engine/transfer-pow.ts, engine/kernels.ts, engine/wasm-kernels.ts; tests)

- Layered TIFF: readLayeredTiff (1.69.6) was only reachable after the PSD branch of openFiles, which a .tif never entered; importFiles now sends a TIFF opened as a document to openFiles when its tag 37724 block holds a Layr (8-bit) record. 16 and 32-bit layer records stay on the flat path (the reader returns null for them).

A real GPU may fuse multiply-adds (GLSL ES 3.00 has no `precise`), so re-check on hardware.

Masked Hue folders refuse.
- transfer-pow.ts (a shared double-arithmetic pow in TypeScript and the `transfer` WebAssembly kernel) is bit-identical between the two but slower than Math.pow for Levels and Exposure, so the lead left it unwired from compose-float.ts; kernels.ts still records the stages. Wire it only with a faster shared pow.

## Live shapes combine, native folder rounding, ComfyUI re-upload only when lost · _v1.92.3 (engine/shape-paths.ts, engine/index.ts, app.ts, gpu/native-display.ts, io/api.ts, io/comfy.ts, ui/panels/connection-settings.ts; tests)

- Combine Shapes: live Rectangle and Ellipse layers (createShape: a raster with a `shape` and no `vector`) are converted on the fly by liveShapeVector (from the transform box, corner radius or four radii via cornerRectPath) inside the one edit(); placedPath reads `l.vector ?? this.liveShapeVector(l)`. The combined back layer becomes a vector shape and loses its live corner parameters.
- Native folders: the CPU canvas blends a non-opaque folder in 8-bit premultiplied with div255 = (v + 255) >> 8 in difference, exclusion, darken, lighten, multiply, screen, overlay and hard light; the native group tile now rounds each layer to 8-bit premultiplied and uses that arithmetic, output alpha by floor. Hue, Color Burn, Saturation, Vivid Light and Reflect still differ (Reflect even from the CPU's own group capture through the formula) and stay CPU. GROUP_BLENDS gained ten modes.
- The luminance blur for Shadows/Highlights and HDR Toning is stored as hi/lo bytes in an Rgba8 target (about 16 bits); Rgba32Float is not renderable on GL.
- GPU brush: the remaining GPU/CPU mismatch is per-pixel float32 against the CPU's float64 (one ulp near a .5 boundary flips a byte), not accumulation or the write; the declines stay.
- Desktop: the WebKitGTK window is not cross-origin isolated with COEP credentialless (SharedArrayBuffer undefined), so the worker pool takes the transfer route there; a banded 16-bit blur gives the same pixels as single thread in the real window.

## GPU Threshold, native Negation, Dissolve and 3D tables, float filters and seeds, depth-limited preview, control roles, GPU brush coverage · _v1.91.7 (gpu/display.ts, gpu/blend-wgsl.ts, gpu/gl-display.ts, gpu/native-display.ts, engine/index.ts, engine/deep-filters.ts, engine/filters-lib/dither.ts, ui/panels/filter-panel.ts, ui/panels/depth-limit.ts, engine/types.ts, ui/panels/references.ts, ui/panels/comfyui-run.ts, engine/gpu-dab.ts, engine/stroke.ts, ui/prefs.ts, ui/panels/page-prefs.ts; e2e tests)

- Threshold (mode 105): `299*r + 587*g + 114*b >= 1000*level` in integers, exact in float32; the CPU tests in doubles, so 5,457 of 16.7 M colours (exact ties) differ by one step at one level each. The level rides in size.x since the layer has no image. Threshold stays listed in LUT3_KINDS but the new branch runs first (it never passed the table proof). The native display now refuses any layer with no image and no table; before, frame() skipped it.
- Native: Reflect and Glow formulas were ported, but translucent pixels differ from the engine by up to 56 and 13 levels (8-bit premultiplied sources amplified near s=1), so the lead kept their refusal; Negation (1 level), Dissolve (2 levels on translucent) and 3D tables (1 level at half opacity) draw natively. Removed: `if (l.lut3) return 'an adjustment uses a 3D lookup table, which the native renderer does not draw yet';`, `if (l.blend === 'dissolve') return 'a layer is in Dissolve mode, which the native renderer does not draw yet';`.
- Float filters: deepFilter used this.seed and ignored settings.seed, so replays at depth drew a new random sequence. colorToAlphaDeep clamps to [0, ceiling] like the 8-bit path; ntscColors declines at 32 bits (YIQ on linear light). hexRgb is exported.
- Depth preview: withPreviewRange swaps p.selection for the call and the coverage read (the preview's show() reads the selection after the filter) and restores it in finally; nothing is written to history.
- Control roles reuse the role field and the upload kinds ("control <role>"); the backend takes the topmost layer per role and keeps control nodes out of the main-picture pick. replaceBase keeps reference layers only.
- GPU brush coverage: an R32F texture with blendFunc(ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA) and source (ks, 0, 0, ks) gives c + (1 - c)ks; the tip is the 8-bit TipAlpha; windowed strokes and anything beyond the plain round dab decline to the CPU; one context per stroke, read back per compose.
- Tiled brushes: wetScratch and the layDual scratch are keyed at 1/16 px so tiled dabs land where the flat ones do; the dual-brush decline on tiled layers is lifted. Texture on tiled layers still declines.
- Dashes with round or square caps: the pattern becomes `[Math.max(0.001, 4*w - width), 2*w + width]`, since each cap grows the dash by half the width on both ends and closed the gaps.
- Develop Distortion: FS_DISTORT is a second pass after the tone pass, sampling the tone output with the lens and vignette maths of the CPU path; opticsGpuOnly says when the optics need nothing else from the CPU.

## Float filters and Develop stages, GPU clip bases with vector masks and worker masked effects, Generator SVG and folders, plug-in selection and 16-bit data and panels, window jobs over MCP, ComfyUI recipe versions, WebAssembly patch, giant stroke seams, Quick Shape lateness · _v1.91.4 (engine/deep-fx.ts, engine/deep-filters.ts, engine/filters-lib/blur.ts, engine/filters-lib/render.ts, engine/filters-lib/noise.ts, engine/develop.ts, ui/panels/filter-panel.ts, engine/index.ts, engine/renderer.ts, engine/composite-worker.ts, engine/fx-jobs.ts, engine/fx-wire.ts, io/image-assets.ts, io/api.ts, app.ts, plugins/host.ts, automation/agent-bridge.ts, automation/command-meta.ts, io/comfy.ts, ui/panels/connection-settings.ts, engine/wasm-kernels.ts, engine/retouch.ts, engine/kernels-wasm/formvis-kernels-patch.wasm, engine/stroke.ts, engine/dab-buffer.ts, extensions/tools/quick-shape.ts)

- Float filters: DeepEnv carries the 8-bit LibFrame's area and canvas rectangles (from engine.filterFrame) so area- and canvas-anchored filters match an offset layer; DEEP_FRAMED filters keep the 8-bit path under a selection, DEEP_RGB_ONLY ones on CMYK and Lab. Thresholds in levels compare as value times 255 (Trace Contour at level minus 1e-3 for float32 k/255). Trace Contour and Mezzotint decide on unrounded values, so 16-bit results flip on a few pixels against 8 bits by design; Color Halftone's dot radius follows the unquantised mean. Lens Flare is `1 - (1-d)(1-min(1, add*k/255))`. OUTLINES and GHOSTS are exported.
- Develop at depth: every stage after the per-pixel pass runs on a Float32 copy on the 0 to 255 scale, so the 8-bit formulas stay as written; `parametricCurve` evaluates the tone curve on floats; blurPx repeats blurDeep's premultiplied three-box blur. Stacked stages differ from 8 bits by up to 3.3 levels because 8 bits rounds between stages. developDeep refuses only a non-RGB layer and the depth-map Dehaze option. 32-bit values above white still clip.
- GPU: a clipping base's vector coverage becomes one more parent clip spec, so no shader changed. Masked styled layers send one document-size coverage surface (folder masks times clip base) to the effect worker as an ImageBitmap, cached per key, up to 4 and only to 16 MP; synchronous cost per edit fell from 112-204 ms to 0-3 ms. Removed: the 'a clipping base with a vector mask' reason and `vecFor(up).length` in clipOf's nested check.
- Generator: `/io/export-beside` writes atomically into `<document dir>/<folder>` after checking the X-Formvis header and names; jpg and webp numbers above 10 are percent, 1 to 10 the old scale; SVG uses fill, stroke and evenodd (gradients and patterns fall back to the fill colour).
- Plug-ins: depth 16 on an 8-bit layer is v times 257 flagged deep false; a Uint16 put to an 8-bit layer is v divided by 257; panel frames are sandboxed allow-scripts with a content security policy and removed on unload.
- MCP window jobs: the window is asked through the bridge (`__jobs`, `__job_stop`, 5 s), only with a live, allowed window; ids are prefixed `window:`. Notifications can repeat a uri when a selection change also fires a doc event.
- ComfyUI recipe versions: the last five replaced texts per recipe in localStorage; Send inputs keeps only mirrored names the recipe text contains.
- WebAssembly patch: insideDistance and scaleHealCorrection behind the `patch` feature; 0 mismatches over 319,248 bytes in Node and identical output before and after the chunk loads in Chromium.
- Giant stroke seams: flush() now only commits tiles and keeps the undo patches; ensure() cuts the window back to the current dab plus 1,024 px and carries the coverage, paint and pre-stroke originals over the overlap (StrokeBuffer.resize keeps the overlapping part). Measured 0 differing pixels against an untiled layer at 50% opacity, soft, low flow, sampled tip and inside a selection. A stroke that loops back more than about 8k px reads painted tiles as its base. Removed: the old flush() body that reset the window to 1 x 1. Quick Shape re-arms its hold timer when it fires more than 120 ms late (a stall), measured in a forced stall.

The clone is never released when a layer is deleted, so a later write copies each such tile once; bounded by the tile count. The parts writer sits under `/api/bands/psdl` (a `/psd/layered` path would be captured by `/psd/{key}`). Checked by Node on scratch fixtures (sha256-equal rows); the browser open, New Document at 40,000 by 2,000 and the parts export were not seen end to end. Knockout: dst times (1 minus a0 times ko), then the backdrop composite times a0 under it; Blend If reads the pre-knockout backdrop. Measured on SwiftShader against the CPU: 9 of 13 documents within 2 levels, a few edge samples at 3. Effect maps: a damage rectangle per layer version rebuilds only the changed part (`partialMaps`, off by default; 0 levels different, 36 against 215 ms at 400 by 300). - Claude Code dock (the owner's request, as in formlit): `icons.ts` gains formlit's `agent`, `agentChat` and `terminal` (stroke 1.75); the dock head is tabs, New Terminal, Chat, Claude Code, Restart and Hide (close icon); Chat is a `ChatPane` on the stream-JSON routes (`/api/agent/claude/*`) with tool chips and a hand-off that opens a Claude Code tab resuming the session; a Claude Code tab is a PTY from `POST /api/terminal/claude`; the ask bar types into the running tab or opens one. `openClaude` rejects an answer without an id and `mount()` ignores a known id, so no blank or duplicate tab; a bare 404 or 405 says to restart the engine; `claudeCodeStatus()` falls back to the old status route. Title bar buttons call `termDock.toggleKind` (syncChrome rewrites data-cmd titles) and follow `termDock.onTab`. The note is absolutely placed and the ask bar is a fixed row, so nothing reflows; closing the last tab shows the empty state instead of hiding the dock. `ui_key` refuses while focus is inside the dock (it could type into a terminal). The sparkle icon is not ported (formlit's `icons.ts` still defines it); `setup/line_counts.py` now fails on it.
- Select and Mask Workspace (P08, behind its own command while the walk is verified): the refined view is drawn by a tool lent through `setDialogTool`, so the stage's pan, zoom and rotation are reused; regions hide by one class on the app root (`is-selmask`, visibility only, no reflow); preview at most 1024 px on the long side with the dialog's maths; OK refines at full size as one step. Select > Select and Mask still opens the dialog, so the dialog's tests and flows are unchanged.
- Masks beyond the layer (P07): a mask stroke starting outside the mask pixels, or within the brush radius plus 2 of their edge, grows the mask to the canvas (new area white): a mask tied to the pixels grows through `growLayer`, one with its own box through `growMask`; skipped for groups, adjustment, tiled, live type, smart, shape, vector and fill layers, scaled or rotated layers and documents over 25 million pixels.
- Layer roles and references (P06, P24): `Layer.role` (reference, subject, background, style) with `layerRoleOf` treating the old `reference` flag as Reference; both saved now (the flag never was); references go to ComfyUI only, fal and local still refuse @img tokens and the panel says so; drops use `Stage.docPoint`. Fixed: `.cv-props-grid` and `.cv-props-field` display rules beat `hidden`, so six empty live-shape fields showed for every layer.
- Smart objects (P07, P15, P16): `smart-cache.ts` keys stages by source raster id and version, padding, each filter's kind, blend, opacity, settings and mask version, copies in and out, 128 MB LRU, stages over a third of the budget not kept; a change of total filter reach changes every key. `SmartObject.original` is dropped wherever a new source enters (`restack` with a source). PSD: embedded PSD contents open as nested layers; a custom mesh opens as a live Warp when the placement is a parallelogram and the nodes land on the pixels, else a note; nested contents are written as an embedded PSD (type code assumed). Measured: an unchanged five-filter stack 760 ms to 3 ms.
- GPU style maps (P25): `GlFilters` builds exact Euclidean distance passes (columns then rows) and Gaussian alpha blurs; above 8 px the shadow mirrors the CPU's half-size blur; Create Layers stays on the CPU (`exactFx`), because dividing by silhouette alpha amplified rounding; contours, noise, gradient strokes, Satin and Bevel stay CPU. `Renderer.previewPixels` scales 0.7 after a build over 90 ms and 1.25 under 25 ms (0.25 to 6 MP). Measured on SwiftShader: every effect within 2 levels of the CPU, blur 40 at 3.
- Half-float and HDR (P25): deep layers upload premultiplied half floats in display encoding (32-bit linear light sRGB-encoded, unclamped above 1), the frame composites in half float only when a deep layer is in it, 32-bit documents with an adjustment layer keep 8-bit textures (the lookup index is 0 to 255), mip chains made on demand with `lod` in the 224-byte uniform; `GpuDisplay.hdr()` configures rgba16float with extended tone mapping only when the preference allows and the screen reports high dynamic range (verified with a stubbed media query only). Stroke surfaces keep a damage log (`noteSurface`, `damageOf`), recycled surfaces noted whole. Measured: a 16-bit ramp keeps 1,024 distinct values on the GPU against 14 at 8 bits.
- Worker compositing (P25): `composite-worker.ts` runs the same Renderer on a band with the view moved up by its top, so modes, masks and Dissolve match by construction; only integer-translation views with layers 1:1 on the grid take the band route (resampling is not band-independent); raster keys are id and version; layer bytes times workers stay under 1.2 GB. 0 bytes different on 28 random documents; no speed-up measurable on this two-core box; the stage swap was not watched in the window.
- WebAssembly kernels: resample (tap weights still built in TypeScript, the two accumulation passes in WebAssembly with a round-half-to-even byte store), dither (matrix from TypeScript) and the first loop of the healing blend; 520 random cases per kernel byte-identical.
- PSD and swatches (P15, P16): Color Lookup layers round trip as live layers; shape pattern content gets a GUID in the pattern library and reads back with a grey stand-in colour; .aco colour-book entries keep their raw record. Export uses the save picker except under automation, in an iframe or with an export folder set.

- Type (P14): `TextSpec.paras` is a list by paragraph index (align, edge, indentFirst, indentLeft, indentRight, spaceBefore, spaceAfter, lastLine, bidi) with trailing empties trimmed; `shiftParas` gives a paragraph split by Enter its settings and keeps the first on a join. `edge` (start or end) is separate from `align` so the physical align union used by PSD import and styles did not widen. The Paragraph panel writes to the caret paragraphs once two paragraphs exist or an override does; a layer-wide `setType` clears the same keys from every paragraph so overrides cannot win silently. `wrapLines` takes break units from Intl.Segmenter only for words holding Han, Kana, Thai, Lao, Khmer or Myanmar, so Latin and Arabic layout is unchanged (70 of 70 samples equal to the old breaker); a closing mark stays with the word before it. The last line of right-to-left justified text goes right only when paras or edge exist, so old layers render as before. Move while editing is Ctrl or Cmd+Alt+arrow (plain Ctrl+arrow is word navigation) and Ctrl-drag on the box; the textarea node is kept and Ctrl+Enter commits text and move as one step. `glyph-outlines.ts` `plain()` refuses paras and edge so those layers trace pixels. Measured: two paragraphs left and right with a 30 px indent and 16 px space before put line 2 ink at x 181 to 491 against line 1 at 9 to 263.
- Fonts (P14): 15 latin woff2 families in `public/fonts/[family]/` with their OFL texts (711,203 bytes); `bundled-fonts.ts` registers a face through the FontFace API only when a layer or the font menu needs it, the weight it needs (the menu loads 400 only); the Character panel select warms once on pointerenter, focus or pointerdown and now rebuilds only when its key changes. `font-names.ts` is the one PostScript-name lookup (`noteFamilies`, `notePostscript`, `resolveFace`) used by the font menus and PSD type. `SCRIPT_FALLBACKS` gained Cyrillic and Greek; untagged Han takes the interface locale's CJK face first. User fonts come from the engine (`loadUserFonts`). opentype.js cannot read woff2, so outlines for the new families come from the engine file route or traced pixels. Measured: zero font requests at start; a Playfair Display layer fetched only its 400 file.
- Languages (P20): Greek (`el`) and Serbian Latin (`sr-Latn`, named like pt-BR) in all three tables with the German key set; `systemLang` walks navigator.languages from the full tag to its prefixes with aliases (zh-Hant, zh-HK, zh-MO to zh-TW; zh to zh-CN; pt to pt-BR; no and nn to nb; es-419 and es-US to es-MX; sr to sr-Latn), and the saved choice always wins. `tn()` serves the PSD report, missing fonts and earlier states counts; Serbian carries #one, #few and #other forms. `native-menu.ts` labels go through `t()` and rebuild on a language change (Hide and Quit stay the system's). `io/api.ts` registers its focus listener only where a window exists, so modules importing i18n load in the unit tests. Arabic filled to the full key set; Hindi's long-tail table is still English.
- Preferences and shortcuts (P20): `kys-import.ts` reads markup (name and key as attributes, children or text) and text lines (`name = keys`, tab, colon, comma, two spaces, quoted pairs or keys last), uses a menu path's last segment, reads UTF-16, maps Ctrl, Cmd, Meta and Win to Mod and Option to Alt, and maps names to command ids through the catalogue's labels; the first-start notice (`formvis.shortcutNotice`) is skipped under automation like What's New. `transformPrefs.legacy` and `samplingDefault`; `previewMode.low` (a 0.5 MP preview copy; Full Resolution wins); the memory line reads performance.memory, else measureUserAgentSpecificMemory when isolated, plus the engine's resident size; `typePrefs.glyphProtection` off makes `fallbackCss` plain sans-serif. Auto interface scale keeps 100 percent when devicePixelRatio is above 1 (the system already scaled) and gives 150 from 3000 px and 200 from 3800 px wide. Fixtures for the KYS reader were written from its layout, not exported by another application.
- AI settings (P20): template front matter `use` and `for`, `generatePrompt` per route (the template naming the route wins, else one with no `for`), assistant templates appended to the system message; `recipes()` is the built-ins not hidden plus `keptRecipes()`, and built-ins are never written to the recipes folder; crop and stitch `expand` (1 to 4) and `grow` (0 to 256 px, binarised at 128, a square spread, sent as RGB equal to alpha so alpha and luma readers agree); refusal times and last four on language model rows; the GPU readout callback in Performance; Preset Manager Alt+Up and Alt+Down and the Export All kind boxes. No tile atlas exists, so SC-AI-0345 has no atlas budget to set.
- GPU compositor (P25): Dissolve is keyed by document pixel through a `vinv` uniform so it matches the CPU at any zoom; Blend If copies `renderer.blendIf` (8-bit unpremultiplied, Rec. 601 grey, underlying alpha 0 uses factor(255)) and applies to coverage after mask and clip; channel restrictions through `chOff`; nested clipping renders the parent coverage first and passes it as the child's clip (chains to 8 deep). The layer uniform grew from 128 to 224 bytes. `surface.ts` keeps a 32-entry damage log (`damageSince`); a caller passing `touch(rect)` promises every changed pixel is inside; WebGL2 tile uploads go through a scratch 2D canvas in copy mode so premultiplied bytes match the full upload; `residency.ts` keeps idle textures within the budget minus the frame's own and frees those idle over 60 s (budget 0 is the old behaviour). Measured on SwiftShader: Dissolve and Blend If within 2 levels of the CPU, nested clips within 3 to 4 on a few edge values; a 16 by 16 write uploads one 262,144 byte tile instead of the 3,145,728 byte layer.
- WebAssembly kernels (P25): `native/formvis-kernels` (no dependencies, +simd128) builds one module per feature (mask, tone, blur); `wasm-kernels.ts` compiles each with compileStreaming (arrayBuffer fallback) on first use, caches it, never retries a failed one, reopens an instance past 768 MiB and returns to TypeScript for small inputs, non-integer seeds, NaN tolerance or any trap. Byte identity by construction: the same operation order in f64, Math.round as floor(x+0.5) on exact halves, f32 stores like Float32Array. URLs are `new URL(..., import.meta.url)` (no start-up requests). The page has no content policy, so none changed; a future page policy needs 'wasm-unsafe-eval'. Build: `cd native/formvis-kernels && RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+simd128" cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features [mask|tone|blur]`, then copy `formvis_kernels.wasm` to `frontend/src/engine/kernels-wasm/formvis-kernels-[feature].wasm`. Measured: 212 random cases equal to TypeScript; Enhance Edge 451 to 78 ms at 2000 by 1500.
- Performance HUD (P25): `perf-hud.ts` builds once and updates text nodes only (0 child-list mutations measured), z-index from the token; `gpu-timing.ts` wraps EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 and WebGPU timestamp-query (asked for only when the adapter has it); stand-in devices gave the right numbers, real hardware not seen. Pointer prediction feeds the brush hover from getPredictedEvents while dragging with Low-latency drawing on.

- Smart objects (F1): Convert to Smart Object takes groups, adjustment, shape and type layers and mixed selections; they live on inside as a nested document (`NestedContents`, `SmartObject.nested`, `nestIntoSmartObject`, `cloneNested`, `cloneSmart`) to any depth, saved as `<layerId>.n.<file>`; Edit Contents, Replace and Convert to Layers follow. Measured: a 3-layer group became one object with 4 nested layers, the pixel unchanged, and both levels of a nested object survived save and load. Nested rasters are not in the memory accounting. Mask paint colour choice (`maskPaint`: follow, white, black).
- Filters and depth (F2): a `filter` adjustment kind runs any filter on everything beneath it with mask, Limit, opacity and blend (`filterLayerHook`, `addFilterLayer`, `setFilterLayerSettings`, commands `new-filter-layer`, `set-filter-layer`; no dialog yet). Its label is kept off the enumerable label map on purpose so the adjustment pickers do not list it (`Object.defineProperty` in adjust.ts). Depth edge snap weighs RGB distance (red/green step 255,255,0,0 instead of 178,145,110,77); Dehaze from colour and tone, dark channel or depth map with Density; `pathBlurDeep`, `lensBlurDeep`; Vanishing Point stamp hardness and opacity.
- GPU (F3): Smudge dabs on WebGL2 (`GlFilters.smudge`, `GpuSmudge`, `WarpStroke.useGpu`) from 48 px up, CPU fallback; within 2 levels of the CPU on SwiftShader; slower than the CPU on software GL.
- Memory (F4): `shrinkPatch` cuts each history patch to its changed box, then to changed 256 px tiles under 60 percent coverage: 48 MB to 0.72 MB for one 300 px change on a 3000x2000 layer; undo and redo restore the pixels.
- Merge and depth (F5): Photomerge "Fill transparent edges" by the adaptive Content-Aware Fill (`fillTransparentWithContent`; no Poisson blending, no seam carving); Auto-Blend Seamless Tones as a smooth spatial gain field (gain error 0.006 against 0.059 flat); `medianDeep`, `embossDeep`, `findEdgesDeep`; more Arabic and Hindi drafts.
- Plugins (F6): WebAssembly ABI v2 (`wasm-abi2.ts`, `filter2`, manifest `formats`, `models`, `alpha`) for 8, 16-bit and float data in RGB, CMYK and grey with alpha handling, v1 unchanged (measured with a real Rust module, examples/wasm-filter-v2); a read-only extra plug-ins folder; Glass sheen texture; Film Look tonal contrast; 3D scenes kept with the document (`Doc.glb`, `glbKeep`, `glbRestore`); the dev server's plugin worker gets a closed policy too (`pluginWorkerPolicy` in vite.config.ts; same-origin imports still reach the dev server there).
- Automation (F7): `.atn` Invert and Unsharp Mask steps; `export-to-file` writes TGA (24 or 32 bit, RLE), DPX (8 to 16 bit, transfer) and layered TIFF with `options`, used by the CLI.
- Generation (F8): Improve sends a picture of the area to vision language model rows and keeps @img tokens; Generate Image size and result choices; Refine for local fill; steps, CFG and named presets for local models; Assistant shortcut Alt+Mod+J. The @ list verified in the browser.
- Panels (F9): spring-loaded document tabs while dragging layer rows (650 ms); thumbnails framed by the canvas shape with a size tag; tab strips overflow into a chevron menu; single-tab groups drag by their tab; `panel-close-group` and the other panel commands fixed for Layers tabs (`dockIdOfGroup`); dialogs move by their title and reopen where left; Grid Settings live beside the canvas; cursor badges for Bucket, Count, Red Eye and the pens.

- Camera Raw (E1): a shared on-canvas probe (`develop-probe.ts`, `createDevelopProbe`) for the mixer's targeted drag (band from the colour, Saturation, Luminance or Hue by drag) and Point Color by click; Upright Guided with guide lines (`uprightFromGuides`); a Lab a* b* scope (`labScope`). Measured: a 40 px drag took red 200,50,50 to 250,28,28; two converging guides gave Vertical -25.
- Selection (E2): Detect Faces for Skin Tones (`faceWeight`, YuNet through the existing route; model run not tested); Skew, Distort and Perspective on a Transform Selection outline, committed as the warped alpha (`carryWarped`, `keepFloat`). Measured: a 200x120 selection with moved corners became 260x120; one undo restores it.
- Type (E3): per-run horizontal and vertical scale (`scaleX`, `scaleY` in RunAttrs, `type-range-style` `scale_x`, `scale_y`); a character style options editor and override list (`updateCharacterStyle`, `characterStyleOverrides`, `runPatchOfStyle`). Measured: "Hello wide" 210 px to 301 px with 200 percent on 4 letters.
- Shapes (E4): magnetic Freeform Pen (width, contrast; mean deviation 5.00 to 1.67 px); Path Selection drags, Alt-copies and nudges several chosen paths; Stroke Path with the Mixer Brush; pattern paint for shape fill and stroke (`ShapePattern`, `shapePattern`), saved with the project; Shape tool path operations; Shapes panel new, rename, group, move, edit as work path, replace and reset; Properties shape detail.
- Warps (E5): Adaptive Wide Angle Perspective, Full Spherical and Auto models, constraint orientation, local straightening and smart filter use (`fitLens`, `runWideAngleSmart`, kind `wideangle`); Vanishing Point focal length and child depth (`estimateFocal`); bicubic Catmull-Rom sampling in mesh warp, Perspective Warp and High-quality distort. Measured: radial fits recover 0.45 exactly; two leaning verticals 30 px to 0.01 px.
- PSD (E6, E7): 16 and 32-bit RGB and grey open at their depth (`pristine` buffer copy, `deepOfPixels`); stroked gradient shapes read (`gradOf`); artboard presets and guides kept; empty pixel layers written and read instead of dropped; `export-artboards-files` takes `names`. Measured: 16-bit 0.75, 0.5, 0.125 exact; 32-bit 3.5 kept; a 7-layer document through Package (PSD and PSB) and the layered CLI convert (PSD, PSB, ORA, FVD, PNG) came back with 7 layers.
- Preferences (E8, E9): Large Tabs and Narrow Options Bar; HUD hardness, pixel-grid snapping of vector points, transform readout, rollover highlight, flick panning; channels in colour, dynamic colour sliders, canvas border, favourite themes (`next-favourite-theme`); Export Clipboard; the layered TIFF prompt and Maximize PSD on File Handling; point units for type size; swatch names in Preset Manager and an include-built-ins export option.

## Owner UI: expanded rail lists every tool and scrolls with a pinned bottom block; title bar row with the document name and "formvis 2026", the tab row above the options bar with the brand over the rail; plus adjustment limits, gradient fill stop editor, depth detail, iris roundness, deep gallery blurs, smart filter rows, Channels mask rows, layers across documents, menu keyboard, snapping for every tool, background save snapshot, grid unit · _v1.90.3 (ui/rail.ts, ui/caption-buttons.ts, ui/tabs.ts, ui/view-tiles.ts, styles/shell.css, styles/tokens.css, styles/panels.css, engine/limit.ts, engine/renderer.ts, ui/panels/adjust-panel.ts, ui/panels/fill-layer-dialog.ts, engine/fill-layers.ts, engine/depth-map.ts, engine/blur-gallery.ts, ui/panels/blur-pins.ts, engine/deep-filters.ts, ui/panels/filter-panel.ts, engine/filters-lib/drawn.ts, engine/develop.ts, ui/layers.ts, ui/channels.ts, ui/properties.ts, extensions/tools/move.ts, engine/layer-structure.ts, ui/menu.ts, ui/stage.ts, extensions/tools/lasso.ts, extensions/tools/gradient.ts, extensions/tools/ruler.ts, extensions/tools/slice.ts, extensions/tools/color-sampler.ts, extensions/tools/brush-common.ts, engine/gradients.ts, ui/panels/gradient-editor.ts, io/project-io.ts, ui/prefs.ts, ui/app-dialogs.ts, engine/pixel-move.ts, engine/index.ts, automation/agent-bridge.ts, automation/catalogue.ts, app.ts, automation/command-meta.ts, styles/dialogs.css)

- Rail (D1, the owner's request): the expanded state is `is-double` (`rail-columns`); it now shows one `.cv-rail-all` button per tool (`Rail.all`, `makeAll`), built once and reordered in place by `applyLayout`, updated by `sync`; the tool list scrolls with its scrollbar hidden; `.cv-rail-bottom` (colours, then Quick Mask and Screen Mode side by side, a little lower) is pinned. Measured: 53 buttons for 53 tools; at 1400x600 scrollHeight 820 over 364, scrollTop to 400 with the bottom block fixed at 476..564; Quick Mask and Screen Mode tops equal; the same nodes after a tool change. The collapsed state keeps one tool per group with the bottom block pinned and the two buttons stacked. Hidden `.cv-tool` buttons were not hidden before (no global `[hidden]` rule): `.cv-rail-tools [hidden]` added.
- Title bar (D2, the owner's last screenshot): on the macOS desktop the page's header is the window title bar (overlay style, hidden native title, traffic lights inset; `wantsOverlayTitleBar`, `has-overlay-titlebar`, drag regions); the row shows "• name" (`.cv-tb-doc`, from tabs.ts), "formvis 2026" centred (`.cv-tb-app`) and the tools; the word formvis is gone from the header; the tab row moved out of `.cv-stage-col` into `.cv-main` above the options bar (`--cv-tabs-h`), the brand icon at its left over the rail; the dock still starts under the title row; tiled arrangements no longer reserve a tabs row. Measured in the browser: title 0..40, tabs 40..74, options 74..114, stage from 114; brand 0..52 with the rail 52; centre title within 0 px of the window centre; 2-up, 3-up and 4-up tiles sized with no zero tile. The real macOS window is built, unverified.
- Effects and layers (D4, D5): a Limit on adjustment layers by luminosity, depth or colour range with Show the effect (`limit.ts`, `Renderer.adjust`, `showLimit`; GPU declines limited layers); a gradient fill stop editor with offsets; `depth-map-detail`; per-iris roundness and blur with a handle, the Iris delete fix; Radial, Field, Iris and Tilt-Shift at float depth (`variableBlurDeep`, `radialBlurDeep`, `deepGalleryFilter`); 34 tree kinds; negative Dehaze adds haze. Measured: luminosity 0..30 inverted only the dark pixels; deep blurs within 0.21 levels mean of the 8-bit result.
- Panels (D3, D6): smart filter rows under a smart object in Layers (`syncSmartList`; reorder, move, Alt copy, delete); Layer Mask and Quick Mask rows in Channels; Properties live actions for shapes and artboards; Move tool drag onto another document's tab copies layers (`tabDrop`); `copy-layers-to-document` with offsets or a new document; `panel-close-group`.
- View (D7): Gradient Editor smoothness, rename and delete; Alt tap menu keyboard navigation with underlined first letters; snap guides drawn for every tool, snapping in lasso, gradient, ruler and slice; Caps Lock precise for every painting tool; `grid-settings`; sampler and copy-drag cursors.
- Saving and grid (D9): `serialize` starts every bitmap encode in one tick, so the document is captured at the start and editing goes on during a save (`saveTask`, `saveHolds`, preference `saveInBackground`); tiled layers still hold edits; a second save of the same document is refused. Measured: painting, renaming and adding a layer during a save left the saved file with 0 differing pixels from the state at the start. Grid unit (`gridUnit`, `gridPixels`): 2 cm at 254 ppi is 200 px.

- PSD write (C1): `writeMultichannelPsd` (mode 7, channel names, ink colour and solidity, resolution, profile; PSB too); smart filter stacks written live when every filter maps (`toPsdFilter`); layer styles on groups, the second to tenth instances, contours, choke, noise, range, glow source, anti-alias, global light, satin contour, stroke gradients; a Quick Mask channel; pattern fill scale baked into the tile (`scaledPsdPattern`). Measured: 3 channels 20x10 read back as multichannel at 144 ppi; 4 smart filters read back live with blend and opacity.
- Export (C2): CMYK press profiles in Export As write CMYK JPEG and TIFF through the engine (`cmykTarget`); BMP and TGA in Layers and Artboards to Files, a Choose folder button in the browser (`writeFolder`); loss notes on the to-Files toast (`layerFileLoss`). Measured: JPEG and TIFF 120x90 CMYK with a profile; BMP 43,254 and TGA 43,244 bytes.
- Writers (C3): Indexed Color documents export a palette PNG (`encodeIndexedPng`, `quantize8`, `packIndexed`; round trip difference 0); ORA writes locks and adjustment layers as pictures (`renderThrough`); swatches keep CMYK, Lab and Gray source values and .ase global and spot types; a Package dialog (`PackageDialog`; .fvd, PSD or PSB, links copied; not run in a browser); saves run as a stoppable job (`serializeJob`; edits still held off, no snapshot).
- Document (C4): canvas extension by stretched edge, average colour, mid grey or noise with an optional border selection (`canvas-border.ts`, `resizeCanvasBordered`, `selectCanvasBorder`); `perspective-crop` command and the crop resolution applied; Copy of a targeted alpha or single colour channel copies grey (`channelPixels`); Slice Select promotes an auto slice; the whole XMP packet kept from PSD.
- Preferences (C5): Resize Image During Place and Always Create Smart Objects When Placing (`placeFit`, `placeSmart`, `placePrefs`, `fitTransform` exported); Match System Appearance with light and dark themes (`themeAuto`, `followSystemTheme`). Measured: 400x300 placed on 200x150 fits to 200x150.
- Interface (C6): inline font sizes use the `--fs` tokens; the terminal dock follows the text size (`termFontSize`); Preset Manager gains Layer Styles and Tool Presets and move for patterns and shapes (`stepPattern`, `stepCustomShape`); bundles carry styles and tool presets.
- Automation (C7): `.fvd` routes to the project opener in the agent bridge; a png, psd, ora, fvd, psb, png, fvd, ora, psd convert chain ran end to end with a zero-pixel difference.
- Transform (C9): Free Transform and Rotate on an alpha channel or Quick Mask (`openFloat` alpha, `turnMask`); `transform-numeric` with `transformLayerBy` and the selection transform dialog for layers (`selectionQuad` `from`); Liquify Lasso Freeze and Thaw (`freezePolygon`) and a preview sized to the window. Measured: alpha 90 CW gives 45,20,30x60 from 30,35,60x30; lasso freeze 110 nodes.

- Transform (B1): `edge-fit.ts` `fitEdges` fits a similarity from the band inside the layer's edge to the picture below (three-level Lucas-Kanade; refused above 8% scale, 4 degrees, or without a 0.6 error drop); `matchEdgesBelow` and the command `match-edges-below`. Measured: shifts (3,2) and (-4,5) recovered exactly in about 110 ms; a 40 px shift and noise refused. Warp carries linked vector masks (`warpVector`, `meshForward`, `sourceToGrid`); shape layers take Distort, Skew, Perspective and Warp on the outline (`shapeThrough`, `subdividePath`). Measured: skewed anchors equal the affine expectation; after Warp still a shape layer.
- Warp tools (B2): Vanishing Point keeps several planes with connected planes hinged on the parent's right edge (`connectedQuad`, focal length estimated from the parent's right angles; not shown). Measured: planes 1, 2, 3, then 2 after delete; dialog height 921.6 px before and after. Auto-Align Layers takes `registration` features or intensity (engine side in the backend log).
- Shapes (B3): Paths panel row thumbnails drawn in place (`thumb()`); Stroke Path with Smudge; Path Selection Shift-click and align and distribute buttons (`arrange`); live polygon, star and triangle (`LiveShape`, `VectorLayer.live`, `setLiveShape`) saved in projects; Free Transform scaling redraws vector shapes (`shapeFollowing`, `followPatch`); gradient strokes (`ShapeStroke.gradient`). Measured: star 5 sides 10 anchors, 8 sides 16; distribute 100 to 120; stroke red at the left, blue at the right. `.cv-path-icon` is now unused.
- PSD (B4): `psd-blend.ts` `readChannelRestrictions` reads the full channel restriction list the library cuts short; Blend Clipped Layers as Group and Transparency Shapes read onto the layers and written back (clbl, tsly, brst); gradient and pattern shapes without a stroke open as fill layers behind their vector mask (`shapeFill`). Measured: restrictions [1] read as [true,false,true], kept through write and re-read. 16-bit files still get the restriction note.
- Readers (B5): BigTIFF resolution and profile (`bigTiffResolution`, the `embeddedProfile` branch); SVG clip paths, masks, filters, patterns and images drawn as pixel layers (`SvgPicture`, `needsPicture`, `pictureSvg`); KRA transparency masks (`maskOf`); ORA extra operators; FITS cards and DPX fields as File Info (`header-meta.ts`); a gzip layer stream in PDN unwrapped (no real file tested). Measured: BigTIFF 300 ppi with a 588-byte profile; clip group 30 px wide, 1,800 opaque pixels.
- Merge and measure (B7): Merge to HDR picks 32, 16 or 8 bit with three toning methods (`ToneMethod`, `deepToned` method arg) in Merge and Image > Mode; `measure-record-features` records one row per selection part (`selectionFeatures`). Measured: equalized histogram 506 to 515 per bin; three parts give areas 2000, 600, 20. 41 dialog keys each in the Arabic and Hindi tables (machine drafts for native review).
- Performance (B6): frame pacing (`framePacing`, `FRAME_PACING`; 22 frames in 1.5 s at 66 ms against 91 free), cache tile size for new giant layers (`setTileSize`, `TILE_SIZES`), worker threads (`setBandThreads`), `purge-video-cache` (`purgeVideoCache`), per-layer save progress (`serialize` `step`).
- Type (B8): an Angle field and a Language select in Character; underline, strike and caps per run (`RUN_KEYS`, `attrsFrom`, `runPatchFrom`); Character and Paragraph buttons on the Type bar; `resolveFontName` for local font names (not run in a browser). Measured on 40 px text: ink 3796 plain, 4086 underline, 3938 strike.
- GPU (B9): Grain on the WebGL2 display (`grainParams`, `GRAIN_MODE` 104; CPU and GPU within 1 level at zoom 1, 2 and 4 on SwiftShader); Liquify on the GPU with the CPU path kept (`GlFilters.liquify`, `liquifyImageCpu`; within 1 level at four sizes).

- Selection (A1): `selection-warp.ts` (`selectionQuad`, `warpSelection`) and Transform Selection by numbers (`transform-selection-numeric`, `transformSelectionBy`); Focus Area and Color Range take parameters; Color Range out-of-gamut and localized clusters by distance; Refine Edge brush painting on the preview applied to the document (`applyRefinedToDocument`); Quick Mask from the select host.
- Brushes (A2): nine procedural tips (`procedural-tips.ts`); wheel and barrel rotation (`PenPose.wheel`); texture depth, each-tip texturing and transfer fields; the mixer's share of paint; ABR import into its own group with presets; a live stroke preview in Brush Settings and the picker (`brush-stroke-preview.ts`); number keys set opacity; smoothing state kept per tool; Gradient and Paint Bucket keys.
- Colour (A3): Fill with every pixel blend mode (pixel blends through the existing blend code) and Content-Aware from the Fill dialog; gradient method smoothness, live preview and midpoint curves; out-of-gamut warning swaps to the printable colour; the colour page in Swatches; four colour samplers in Info with `sampler-add`, `sampler-move`, `sampler-delete`, `sampler-clear`; Paint Bucket on the primary button only.
- Retouch (A4): Remove's fill runs in a worker (`retouch-worker.ts`, `retouch-jobs.ts`; `removeFill` split from `removePatch`); the LaMa row shows only when the model is ready (`removeModelReady`), the run itself unverified; Content-Aware Move colour adaptation and rotation; Clone samples through `cloneSampleSurface`. Patent limits kept: no seam carving, no Poisson blending after the adaptive fill, no live fill during the Move drag.
- Camera Raw (A5): a Kelvin row and the camera look checkbox (engine side in the backend log); Lens Correction angle, scale and auto scale; Glow warmth and diffusion.
- PSD (A6): colour modes reported and converted (`psd-modes.ts`), a report dialog (`psd-report-dialog.ts`), layer and vector masks (`maskOf`, `vectorMaskOf`), linked files resolved from the opened set (`resolveLinked`); `openFiles(files, interactive)`. - Effects (A8): a contour editor in Layer Style (`customContourId`, `contourCurve`), `Layer.blendClipped`, `transparencyShapes`, `Doc.stylePresets`, deep-depth filters (`deep-filters.ts`), blur pins on the layer, log sliders up to 1000.
- View (A9): ruler origins (`rulerOrigins`), grid opacity, snap to the selection (`snap-selection`, `snapOptions.selection`) and a hold key, notice duration in Preferences, pen and shape points snapped. The page error "items is not iterable" seen in 1.89.9 was not reproduced and not fixed.

- Plugins (Z4): each folder plugin runs in its own module Worker (`plugin-worker.ts`) whose network, storage and worker globals are replaced with throwers on the global and every prototype above it; the window side (`callIn`, `tell`, `fromWorker`, `dispatch` through the existing `need()` permission checks) answers its messages; panels are built by the app from `ui.*` messages and patched with `textContent` only; filters 30 s, sources 60 s, overlays 2 s. Measured: `window`, `document`, `localStorage` undefined in the plugin; `fetch`, XHR, WebSocket, BroadcastChannel, indexedDB, caches, Worker, sendBeacon blocked. Left: `import()` of a URL still reaches the server with a GET (no CSP on the worker). The plugin API's document calls now return promises; the sample plugin is updated.
- Preferences (Z1): Camera Raw colour space and Sharpen For (`raw-sharpen.ts`, the existing Unsharp Mask), auto show hidden panels at the edges (`autoShowPanels`), the control port shown from the engine.
- Interface (Z2a): Interface Scale in Preferences over the existing CSS zoom; px font sizes scale with UI font size through one generated style (`scalePxFonts`); background documents free their halving caches after a delay (`backgroundReleaseSec`, `releaseBackgroundCaches`, `Renderer.release`; 15,938,000 bytes to 0); update settings with a start check in the page (the desktop shell's own start-up check was removed so updates are asked once, from the page; still gated without a key); the settings location with its override.
- Keys and presets (Z2b): language model rows (name, address, model, vision flag, own key) with only user-entered services; keys refused by a service (401, 403) are flagged until replaced; prompt templates and recipes kept in data folders; brush sets saved and loaded; move up and down for brushes, swatches, gradients; get-a-key links only for the providers already present.
- MCP (Z3a): `open_file` into a document, replacing the base, or as a layer, with SVG; reference layers (`Layer.reference`); `transform_layer` distort and warp; `export_image` to TIFF (layered), TGA, DPX, BMP, EXR, HDR and back to the opened file; `new_document` CMYK with a profile; menu paths in `list_commands`; `ui_set` eyedropper, crop overlay and dock layout; `ui_window` quit with confirmation; sessions expire after 30 idle minutes; a folders-agents-may-use section in Agent Connect. 134 tools.
- Automate (Z5): an Actions dock panel (`createActionsPanel`, Alt+F9), Photomerge as masked layers, an output folder for Image Processor, Batch and batch Lens Correction (`out-folder.ts`), TGA and DPX in Image Processor, a font file for Contact Sheet, Define Variables align and clip, a Save graph bar for ComfyUI recipes, Image Size steps in action files.
- Files (Z7): PSD type style runs written and read (`toPsdStyleRuns`, `fromPsdStyleRuns`), EXIF in PSD (resource 1058), TIFF (with GPS) and PNG (eXIf), alpha channels in layered TIFF, PSD, TIFF and WebP from Batch, Image Asset variants and a folder command.
- Generation (Z6): a per-tool Auto, Ask or Refuse table for the in-app assistant stored in the agent policy store; free width and height in the Generate panel; an @ list in the prompt (not verified in a browser); 16-bit depth output on the depth route.
